negative_reviews.author: Jasi S
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) The food was unfortunately only average – I think it could easily be improved.

Our appetizers arrived after the main courses, which is hard to explain given how quiet the restaurant was.

The service was friendly.

Unfortunately, the price was also difficult to justify.

(Original)
Das Essen war leider nicht mehr als durchschnittlich - ich denke das lässt sich leicht toppen.
Unsere Vorspeisen kamen leider erst nach dem Hauptspeisen, was bei wenig Betrieb wenig erklärbar ist.
Der Service war nett.
Preislich leider auch nur schwer zu vertreten.

negative_reviews.author: Sebastian Schwarz
negative_reviews.text: did not live up to the reviews. Kind service but besides from that nothing to write home about. main dishes where served before the starters and we weren’t to happy with what we had chosen.

issues: Shoreditch took £26.7K with labour contained at 23.4% (London KPI meeting 10/11 and Admin Meeting 09/11).
Spend per head rose to £23.55, the highest in South England for some time, and the site led the region on edamame sales.
Delivery revenue grew from £1,000 to £2,300 over two weeks, and the Google rating was 4.81.
Shoreditch became the first South England site to get a five star EHO rating on a first visit, with no GM or head chef present.
Like Soho, it was overstaffed on a quiet Monday, and labour must be controlled with Jerry and Remy using the new centralised sushi station in BOH.

All sites failed the recent cleanliness and brand standards audits, including staff not acknowledging visitors within 10 seconds, dirty stainless steel sushi worktops, dirty menus, wobbly tables and uniform breaches such as missing kimonos or grey trousers.
For Teddy's book launch on 24/11 the site received only one book instead of a full box.
A head office memo was posted in the Shoreditch management chat on 10/11 and must be read.
The management team is one AGM and two supervisors, plus a part time supervisor.
Last month Shoreditch made a net profit for the first time (London KPI meeting 10/11).
